verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer portal lists a first-party CLI ("CLI Our Command Line Interface.") next to its API and official wrappers, so an official CLI appears to exist. The evidence is a single one-line mention with no detail on installation, commands or behaviour. missing for 10: CLI installation and usage documentation, a command reference, AI-native or agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
